progress_events.note: Готовый независимый участок после настроек: существующий writer/messages/intents, sender из verified binding; schema/lib у Terra.
Начал V027A в чистом изолированном дереве с сохранёнными V033B commits; проверяю существующий Writer/schema перед созданием только correspondence source и fixtures.
V027A durable transaction and reopen proof complete; proceeding to V027B reply authorization using the persisted correspondence.

changes.result: Commit f756793b adds store::correspondence::NewCorrespondence and Writer::record_correspondence (plus required store module registration). A single SQLite IMMEDIATE transaction writes the intent, task, and message; message content_json stores sender_ref only from VerifiedSelfBinding.session, recipient_ref, message_ref, intent_ref, and content. Real SQLite file was closed/reopened through Writer::open_file; assertions recovered sender=session-c, recipient=session-b, message_ref=message-c-b, intent=intent-c-b, while lineage.creator_ref remained session-a. Fake identity-boundary test confirmed request content cannot override sender. `cargo test --manifest-path crates/herder/Cargo.toml store::correspondence::tests --lib`: 2 passed; rustfmt and diff check passed. No schema/lib/Cargo changes.

progress_events.note: Review follow-up 4179eb81 fixes regenerated-ID dedup, reuses existing prepare semantics, and returns stored refs; RED/GREEN and both targeted suites pass.

changes.result: V027A commits f756793b (durable correspondence) and follow-up 4179eb81 (dedup correction). record_correspondence now calls the shared prepare_intent_in_transaction helper, preserving Writer::prepare_intent key/payload semantics inside the same transaction. Same principal/recipient/request_key+payload with regenerated intent/task/message IDs returns Existing plus original refs; changed content or verified sender returns Conflict. RED reproduced the old Conflict for regenerated IDs; GREEN proves original refs returned and exactly one task/intent/message remains. Correspondence tests: 4 passed; existing intents tests: 4 passed; rustfmt and diff check passed. Earlier real SQLite close/reopen proof retained. No schema/lib/Cargo changes; module registration was the single-line hunk already sent to Terra. No external sends.
